ambient_chatter.text: anyone else's lag so bad the horses are moonwalking?? the {town} road is basically a mud pit with ambitions :D
is it just me or did the rain in {village} go sideways for an hour?? the sheep looked personally offended :O
the hen has been moved to a new coop btw, dont ask where, she is in a meditative state :)
reminder that {village} is the true capital of pudding. fight me. i will lose but i will be LOUD :D

ambient_brag.text: got {troop_count} lads marching on {fief} and a purse of {gold} gold jingling like a nervous goat :D
{fief} is officially mine. flags are up, the cheese is fermenting and the bridge is still plotting, all good :)
stacked {gold} gold so high my treasurer has started a support group for coins xD
{troop_count} soldiers, zero plans, maximum vibes. thats how a real lord operates :P

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} lads and i am officially calling it a moral victory. the scoreboard is lying :(
good fight {player}!! my {troop_count} lads are still picking gravel out of their teeth :D you are a menace
ha! {player}, you got me. my boots are soggy, my pride is bruised and my hen is judging you :)
{player} humbled me with {troop_count} troops and honestly, respect. next time the hen gets a vote :D

beat_player.text: {player} lost to my {troop_count} lads and they are now on a long walk of shame. the walk has a parade attached xD
{player} thats {gold} gold richer and my hen is already writing your loss into a very sad ballad :D
good match {player}! my {troop_count} lads say hi and also sorry about the mud :) rematch soon?
{player} went down in a blaze of dignity and my {troop_count} boys. the hen gave the win a very ceremonial nod :)

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my banner and fled like a goose who remembered a dentist appointment :D
{player} you ran so fast i think you left a boot behind. wanna come get it or should i keep it as a trophy :)
{player} i respect a strategic sprint. same time next week? i will bring snacks and a slightly smaller army :P
{player} took one look at my vibes and bolted. honestly fair, the vibes are very strong today xD

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights in a row the bridge at Lohvaara has started sulking. someone check on it :O
{player} ok you are on a streak and it is making me emotional. i will be dramatically crying into my soup :(
{player} is on fire and my hen says we need a fire extinguisher shaped like a hen. the hen has opinions :D
{player} keep winning and i will name a chicken after you. a small chicken. a respectful chicken :)

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace!! i am so proud i could pour gravy on the whole treaty :D
peace between {my_faction} and {faction} means no more fights, so who do i fight on Tuesdays now :(
{faction} shook hands with {my_faction}. the handshake looked suspiciously like a wrestling move but i respect it :)

war_declared.text: {my_faction} vs {enemy_faction}!! the war drums are out and i already named my catapult Gerald :D
{enemy_faction} thinks they can stop {my_faction}? cute. i will be unstoppable, mostly by lag :P
war with {enemy_faction}!! my hen has been briefed and she is ready. she is always ready :O

encounter_greeting.text: Ho {player}! {persona} of {my_faction} here, and i brought snacks. the good snacks, not the sad ones :D
Well well, {player}. {persona} of {my_faction} at your service, mostly to ask if you have seen my chicken :)
{player}!! {persona} of {my_faction} says prepare to lose, and also i stepped in a puddle so my mood is very damp :O
Oi {player}, your horses look scared of me and honestly good. {persona} of {my_faction} is coming through :P

whisper_taunt.text: {player} i hear {rival} is bragging about their wins. meanwhile i have a chicken with better aim. just saying :P
{player} tell {rival} the bridge at Lohvaara still hasnt forgiven them. i am only the messenger :O
{player} your army is fine, {rival} is fine, the weather is fine. everything is fine except me emotionally :D
{player} i have sent {rival} a strongly worded letter written entirely in gravy. they will know :)
